definitions.explanation: A person who studies and researches history as an academic discipline. Refers specifically to professional or academic historians rather than casual history enthusiasts.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}が{講演|こうえん}した。
examples.english: A famous historian gave a lecture.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}たちの{間|あいだ}でも{意見|いけん}が{分|わ}かれている。
examples.english: Even among historians, opinions are divided.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}が、この{事件|じけん}を{近代|きんだい}{日本|にほん}の{転換点|てんかんてん}と{見|み}なしている。
examples.english: Many historians regard this incident as a turning point in modern Japan.

notes:
The standard compound for a professional historian or history scholar. Follows the productive pattern of field + {学者|がくしゃ} (scholar).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}の{見解|けんかい}: a historian's view
- {歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}によると: according to historians
- {著名|ちょめい}な{歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}: a renowned historian

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {史家|しか}: historian — more literary and concise synonym
- {歴史家|れきしか}: historian — slightly less formal variant
- {研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}: researcher — broader term for any academic researcher

FORMS:
{歴史|れきし} (history) + {学者|がくしゃ} (scholar). Same pattern as {経済|けいざい}{学者|がくしゃ} (economist), {政治|せいじ}{学者|がくしゃ} (political scientist), etc.
